event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Tecopsa represented by Javier Mulas Perez.
Pierre Iliver and Jose Angel Maria observing.
facts: Eleonore and Tecopsa were approaching mark 1 on close-hauled converging courses. Eleonore was on starboard tack, Tecopsa was on port.
Tecopsa passed head to wind 2 boat lengths from the mark.
Tecopsa finished the tack 3 meters clear ahead and to leeward from Eleonore.
Eleonore luffed above close-hauled course when the distance between the boats was 3-4 meters and increasing.
conclusions: Eleonore did not have to luff above close-hauled course to avoid contact, therefore RRS 18.3 was not broken.
